commands.name: search-artworks
commands.summary: Search the CMA collection by keyword, with optional filters (type, department, artist, culture, on view, recently acquired), paged by offset

commands.name: get-artwork
commands.summary: Get full details of one artwork by accession number (title, date, artist, culture, medium, measurements, credit line, description, provenance, images)

commands.name: list-related-artworks
commands.summary: List the 'See Also' related artworks shown on an artwork's detail page

commands.name: list-gallery-locations
commands.summary: List the museum's gallery locations (values accepted by the gallery= filter of search-artworks)

commands.name: get-image-zoom-info
commands.summary: Get deep-zoom (DZI) metadata for an artwork image: full pixel width/height, tile size and format

dropped.name: suggest-collection
dropped.reason: The internal autocomplete endpoint returns 401 Unauthorized, and there is no public equivalent.
